resources.string: Module operation failed. Grant Root permission, install and enable the matching wanBox module, then retry. Invalid configurations keep the last working snapshot.
Module networking is managed independently. This Android Service option does not apply; its saved value is retained.

Installer data preparation is incomplete. Stop node tests and subscription updates, check Root/module availability, then reopen wanBox to retry. The full backup is retained and reconnect is blocked until complete.
The installer data selection is waiting to complete. Open wanBox to finish it before connecting. This status does not indicate missing Root permission.
Stop the running node test, then reconnect or reopen wanBox to finish the installer data selection.
Subscription updates have not stopped. Wait for them to finish, then reconnect or reopen wanBox. Existing data and backups are retained.
The installer data selection is invalid or has changed. Keep your backup and export the application log; do not delete application data or the pending selection file.
The installer recovery progress record is unreadable or from an incompatible version. Keep your backup and export the application log; do not delete application data.
Installer data processing failed at: %1$s (%2$s). Existing backups and progress are retained. Reopen wanBox to retry; if it fails again, export the application log.
